💬 **TASK-1308** 有新留言：《Blocksail》城鎮適地遮罩溢位：37 種適地塞進 32 位元，beans⇄sugar 等五對互相冒充（威尼斯、熱那亞多甘蔗園）

# TASK-1308 suit-mask overflow — per-town diff for Tim (2026-11-17)

Branch `gura/suitmask-overflow` (NOT merged into main, NOT pushed): fa162438 fix → 92f9877a merge of main **7a335b32** (gura round 8;
world/start taken whole from main) → **7330ba8a** start-file delta re-applied on 7a335b32. Tip 7330ba8a is a fast-forward of main 7a335b32. Worktree:
`C:/Users/Tim/AppData/Local/Temp/claude/d89b6a7f55a00a4e/28fb0a26-d405-4ac9-bfb6-bbec6dd0cf49/scratchpad/bs-suit`
(baked plans in its world/townplans/; control = main 7a335b32 plans in `.../scratchpad/suit/plans_main2/`).

## Fix
- Mask = ⌈nKeys/32⌉ Uint32 words per point: `BSW.townSuitPut` (town_sample.js) writes, `BSW.townSuitKeysAt` (town.js) reads
  and throws if the word count is too small. `S.suit.w` added; `TOWN_SAMPLE_FMT` 1→2.
- Regression check ③ at the top of tools/town_bake.cjs (all modes, incl. --check): every SUITS key written alone must read back as itself.
- Venice centre: suitAt = suitXY(0,0) = pasture,hardwood,hunt,wheat,barley,clay,hemp,grape,mulberry,beans (no sugar).
- town.js ~2944 (`farm` in ④ road endpoints) only uses indexOf to count FARM keys, no bit op → untouched.

## Bake
50 plans rebaked, `town_bake --check` 56 ✓ exit 0. 9 unchanged (amsterdam, angra, la-rochelle, london, london~blackwall,
marseille, smyrna, st-georges, yallahs~mines). 41 changed — **only ⑬ opening farms** (farm lots + their `clear`);
roads and every non-farm lot byte-identical to main.

| Town | Change | Why |
|---|---|---|
| venice (main), vs 7a335b32 | old: beans 372 / barley 7 / veg 6 / cane 1 → new: veg 257 / barley 66 / beans 6; food 23,245→12,840/day (−45%), farm jobs 2,991→2,558 | cane gone from round 1 → every farm slot shifts by one; Venice is slot-starved (wants 130,000) and townFarms' FARM_TRY=40 cutoff drops a crop from rotation early ⇒ the crop mix flips on tiny perturbations (on base b0f32d60 the same fix gave the opposite: +179 beans). **Chaotic, Tim should look** |
| venice~campalto/chirignago/zelarino | −1 cane (+small farm shuffles) | fake sugar |
| venice~carpenedo/mestre/tessera | −1 cane, +1–2 barley/beans/vegetables | fake sugar |
| venice~dese/favaro | −1 cane, −2..3 barley/beans/vegetables | fake sugar + slot shift |
| genoa, constantinople | −1 cane | fake sugar |
| galata | −1 cane, −1 beans | fake sugar |
| livorno | −cane −cotton −tobacco | fake sugar/cotton/tobacco (from beans/cork_oak/citrus) |
| livorno~elba | −cane −cotton | same |
| seville | −cane −cotton −tobacco, +1 beans | same |
| lisbon, cadiz | −cane −tobacco | same |
| basse-terre-gp, basseterre, bridgetown, campeche, havana, kingston, port-royal, saint-pierre, san-juan, santiago-de-cuba, santo-domingo | −5..−24 beans fields → +maize, +cassava, +vegetables (total field area up 4–14k m²) | beans was fake (aliased from sugar) |
| funchal, garachico | −28 / −7 beans → +barley, +vegetables | same |
| baracoa, charles-town, tortuga, kingston~hope/iron, santiago~el-cobre/hierro/ingenio, yallahs, yallahs~sulfur | −1 beans | same |
| port-de-paix | 1 beans → vegetables | same |

## Start files (world/start)
Plan delta only (guarded plan_delta, extended to district unit plans — district farms live in the city's ledger):
26 buildings.json, +560 / −595 / ~849 rows vs main 7a335b32 (Venice's reset ledger matched the 7a335b32 plans row-for-row), original row order kept. Seville's new beans field → townFoodBase demand `d`
(only Seville kept). Checks vs main 7a335b32: town_bake --check exit 0; town_start ✗ = main's minus Livorno (now matches its plan); land_start, forage_start ✗ identical.
Not done: no year-sim of the food/pop effect.

## Merge
Round 8 already merged (7a335b32); this branch has main merged in, so merging is a ff of main to 7330ba8a — needs a coding session, then copy the
50 worktree plans into main's world/townplans/ and run --check there. If main moves again: reset world/start to main, rebake, re-run plan_delta.
Side note for gura: Venice districts bake with wall-corner-gap ⚠ (campalto 5, carpenedo 1, chirignago 11, dese 14, favaro 12, mestre 14,
tessera 7 + 1 unplaced segment, zelarino 6) — walls are byte-identical to main 7a335b32's plans, so this comes from round 8, not this fix.
Scripts: `.../scratchpad/suit/` (cmp.cjs, plan_delta.cjs with units + order keep, food_base.cjs).

- 狀態：`in_progress`　操作：gura
